question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**according**" is used to indicate that something is based on what someone has said or on a reference. (अनुसार)
 
• In this context, "according to sources" is the appropriate phrase for indicating reliance on information provided by sources.
 
• The other options: "**alike**," "**stated**," and "**congruent**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Under the influence of the system, heavy to moderate rain may occur in some parts of Odisha, **according**__ to sources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Alike **(समान): In a similar or identical manner.

 
 
• **Example:** The twins always dress alike.
 
 
 
• **Stated **(कहा): Express something definitely or clearly in speech or writing.
 
 
• **Example:** He stated his opinion very clearly.
 
 
 
• **Congruent **(समान): In agreement or harmony.
 
 
• **Example:** The results are congruent with our expectations.
